outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game environment plate for an orthographic 2.5D isometric career-world territory
Input images: Image 1 is the sole composition reference. Use its land silhouette, coastline proportions, terrain flow, and large-scale spatial organization only. Do not reproduce its labels, node markers, UI panel, legend, or graph symbols.
Primary request: Render the Tanium territory as a finished environment-only map portion, ready for separately composited landmark assets.
Scene/backdrop: a long inspection escarpment island over very dark near-black water, with the distinctive southeast channel and detached hard-quay tongue preserved.
Subject: preserve the long diagonal inspection ridge running across the territory, stepped sequential terraces and passes, engineered retaining walls, hard quay edges, embedded paved circulation, and broad clear level placement zones at the same approximate locations implied by Image 1. The terrain should feel procedural, controlled, and security-industrial without containing any buildings.
Style/medium: polished monochrome 3D game-map render with restrained technical linework; exact orthographic 2.5D isometric projection, consistent geometry, no perspective convergence.
Composition/framing: landscape frame, entire territory visible with generous dark-water margin; preserve Image 1's elongated asymmetric footprint and southeast channel; do not crop the coastline.
Lighting/mood: controlled upper-left key light, soft contact shadows, readable elevation changes, subdued technical atmosphere.
Color palette: strictly neutral grayscale only, charcoal water/background, medium-gray terrain, pale-gray edge highlights; no colored tint.
Materials/textures: matte stone, compacted aggregate, concrete terraces, sparse rock cuts, subtle contour seams; low visual noise so later buildings remain dominant.
Constraints: environment and topography only. Leave the placement zones broad, empty, level, and readable. No labels, no text, no numbers, no UI panels, no legend, no node diamonds, no markers, no icons, no landmark buildings, no towers, no logos, no people, no vehicles, no graph-link lines, no watermark. Keep the upper-left lighting direction and exact isometric camera consistent across the entire plate.
Avoid: city skyline, decorative sci-fi machinery, saturated accents, photoreal aerial perspective, tilted horizon, fisheye distortion, painterly haze, clutter, asset stand-ins, floating geometry.
